THEARCHITECT-LOOSE_THREAD.title: Loose Thread
THEARCHITECT-LOOSE_THREAD.description: Draw [b]{Cards}[/b] additional card on each of your first [b]{Turns}[/b] turns of combat.
THEARCHITECT-LOOSE_THREAD.flavor: A single loose end is enough.
THEARCHITECT-CROOKED_NEEDLE.title: Crooked Needle
THEARCHITECT-CROOKED_NEEDLE.description: At the start of combat, gain [b]{StrengthPower}[/b] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [b]{DexterityPower}[/b] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-CROOKED_NEEDLE.flavor: It refuses to follow a straight line.
THEARCHITECT-ORANGE_PEARL.title: Orange Pearl
THEARCHITECT-ORANGE_PEARL.description: At the start of combat, gain [b]{ArtifactPower}[/b] [gold]Artifact[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-ORANGE_PEARL.flavor: An imperfection, polished rather than removed.
THEARCHITECT-DIAMOND_HAND.title: Diamond Hand
THEARCHITECT-DIAMOND_HAND.description: At the start of combat, enchant a random card in your opening hand with [gold]Glam[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-DIAMOND_HAND.flavor: The future catches the light differently every time.
THEARCHITECT-UNSPENT_POSSIBILITY.title: Unspent Possibility
THEARCHITECT-UNSPENT_POSSIBILITY.flavor: A choice you have not made yet.
THEARCHITECT-LAST_MEAL.title: Medieval Meal
THEARCHITECT-LAST_MEAL.description: Gain [b]{MaxHp}[/b] max HP. Receive [b]{Potions}[/b] potions and a [gold]rare[/gold] card reward.
THEARCHITECT-LAST_MEAL.eventDescription: Gain [b]{MaxHp}[/b] max HP. Receive [b]{Potions}[/b] potions and a [gold]rare[/gold] card reward.
THEARCHITECT-LAST_MEAL.flavor: You force me to do something I really don't want to do... My diet is ruined! I hope you're happy
THEARCHITECT-BORROWED_TOMORROW.title: Borrowed Tomorrow
THEARCHITECT-BORROWED_TOMORROW.descripti: Gain [b]{Energy}[/b] additional [gold]Energy[/gold] on each of your first [b]{Turns}[/b] turns of combat. At the start of combat, gain [b]{VulnerablePower}[/b] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-BORROWED_TOMORROW.flavor: The debt comes due before the gift.
THEARCHITECT-HANDHELD_MIRROR.title: Handheld Mirror
THEARCHITECT-HANDHELD_MIRROR.description: Acquire a copy of [b]3[/b] random relics you have.
THEARCHITECT-HANDHELD_MIRROR.eventDescri: Acquire a copy of [b]3[/b] random relics you have.
THEARCHITECT-HANDHELD_MIRROR.flavor: It remembers what could have been, not what was.
THEARCHITECT-THE_LAST_WISH.title: The Last Wish
THEARCHITECT-THE_LAST_WISH.description: Upon pickup, gain [b]{Gold}[/b] [gold]Gold[/gold]. At the start of combat, gain [b]{PlatingPower}[/b] [gold]Plating[/gold] and [b]{StrengthPower}[/b] [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-THE_LAST_WISH.eventDescript: Gain [b]{Gold}[/b] [gold]Gold[/gold]. At the start of combat, gain [b]{PlatingPower}[/b] [gold]Plating[/gold] and [b]{StrengthPower}[/b] [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-THE_LAST_WISH.flavor: One final wish, divided between fortune and survival.
THEARCHITECT-GOLDEN_EYE.title: Golden Eye
THEARCHITECT-GOLDEN_EYE.scryPrompt: [gold]Scry[/gold]: Choose any cards to discard. The remaining cards stay in order.
THEARCHITECT-GOLDEN_EYE.flavor: What is seen need not come to pass.
THEARCHITECT-DEUS_EX_MACHINA.title: Deus Ex Machina
THEARCHITECT-DEUS_EX_MACHINA.description: Upon pickup, enchant [b]{Cards}[/b] random unenchanted cards in your deck with [gold]Sown[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-DEUS_EX_MACHINA.eventDescri: Enchant [b]{Cards}[/b] random unenchanted cards in your deck with [gold]Sown[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-DEUS_EX_MACHINA.flavor: A small intervention, planted well in advance.
THEARCHITECT-NUREMBERG_EGG.title: Nuremberg Egg
THEARCHITECT-NUREMBERG_EGG.description: The [b]{Cards}th[/b] card you play each combat is replayed [b]{Replay}[/b] additional times, then [gold]Exhausted[/gold]. Replays do not advance this count. The card gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold] for this combat.
THEARCHITECT-NUREMBERG_EGG.flavor: At the appointed moment, the mechanism breaks its shell.
THEARCHITECT-RITUAL_DAGGER.title: Ritual Dagger
THEARCHITECT-RITUAL_DAGGER.description: At the start of combat, gain [b]{RitualPower}[/b] [gold]Ritual[/gold] and [b]{VulnerablePower}[/b] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-RITUAL_DAGGER.flavor: Every blessing asks for an opening.
THEARCHITECT-VIOLET_LOTUS.title: Violet Lotus
THEARCHITECT-VIOLET_LOTUS.description: Upon pickup, enchant [b]{Cards}[/b] random unenchanted cards in your deck with [gold]Wrath[/gold], and [b]{Cards}[/b] other random unenchanted cards with [gold]Calm[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-VIOLET_LOTUS.eventDescripti: Enchant [b]{Cards}[/b] random unenchanted cards in your deck with [gold]Wrath[/gold], and [b]{Cards}[/b] others with [gold]Calm[/gold].
THEARCHITECT-VIOLET_LOTUS.flavor: The stillness and the storm share a single root.
THEARCHITECT-DEVA_FORM.title: Deva Form
THEARCHITECT-DEVA_FORM.description: After your first mid-combat reshuffle, gain [b]{Energy}[/b] additional [gold]Energy[/gold] each turn, starting next turn. Does not stack with further reshuffles.
THEARCHITECT-DEVA_FORM.flavor: A second breath, held until the next beginning.
